newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian share trade down, stagnation seen.
newsitem.headline: Latvian share trade down, stagnation seen.

text.p: Latvian bourse trade slipped on Wednesday although blue chip stocks made small additions to recent gains amid expectations of some stagnation in the future.
Total turnover fell to 47,000 lats from 73,000 lats and the Rietumu index rose 1.11 percent to 185.84.
On the official list, Unibanka and Staburadze confectionery extended gains. Unibanka was up to 3.45 lats from 3.40 and Staburadze inched up one santime to 2.67 lats.
Unibanka registered trade of 8,000 lats while Staburadze had volume of 3,700 lats.
The market expected no drastic changes in volume terms but looked forward to the listing of Liepajas Metalurgs metal plant in the coming weeks as an enlivening factor.
"There are signs of stagnation at the current low level and any expected turnover increases will be slight," Uldis Bulavs, a dealer with Trasta Bank, told Reuters.

Valmiera Glassfibre and Daugavpils Chain, both usual secondary list leaders, were the most traded on volume of 9,400 lats and 9,200 lats respectively. Valmiera rose two santimes to 1.56 lats while Daugavpils Chain stayed put at 1.25 lats.
Elsewhere on the official list, Riga Transport Fleet was in demand as it traded 3,400 lats of shares and rose to 1.25 lats from 1.22 lats.
Riga Shipyard remained stable at 1.40 lats on trade of 2,800 lats and Kaija cannery edged up one santime to 2.17 lats on volume of 1,000 lats.
